title: Hell, Paradise, and the Shaking of the Hour

paragraphs.text: The disbelievers and what they worship besides Allah will be fuel for Hell. If those false gods were real, they would not enter it. There they will groan and will not hear. But those promised the best reward will be kept far from Hell. They will not even hear its sound. They will live forever in what they desire. The greatest terror will not make them sad. Angels will meet them and say, "This is your promised Day."

On that Day, Allah will roll up the heaven like a written sheet. As He began the first creation, He will repeat it. This is His promise. In the Psalms, Allah wrote that His righteous servants will inherit the land.

Allah sent the Prophet only as a mercy to the worlds. He was told to say that there is only one God, so people should submit to Him. If they turn away, he has warned them all equally. He does not know if the promised punishment is near or far. Allah knows what people say and what they hide. Perhaps the delay is a test. The Prophet asked Allah, the Most Merciful, to judge with truth.

O mankind, fear your Lord! The shaking of the Hour is a terrible thing. On that Day, every nursing mother will forget her baby. People will look drunk though they are not, because Allah's punishment is severe.
